summary: Iter 37 — Phase 6 Scenario Engine (Tool & Statement Integration) fully verified. Backend (pytest 5 passed + 2 skipped — the two budget-exhaustion-projection tests intentionally skip when <14 days into the current quarter): GET /api/scenario/workflows lists 3 workflows with key/label/intro/step_count/advice_boundary; GET /api/scenario/workflows/reassessment returns 3 steps (request → services_australia_letter → completed) where step[0].event_type=reassessment_requested and a completed step carries reassessment_completed; GET /api/scenario/workflows/death returns advice_boundary=ESCALATE with 3 route_out_contacts_resolved (My Aged Care 1800 200 422, Services Australia FIS 132 300, OPAN 1800 700 600); GET /api/scenario/workflows/unknown → 404 {detail:'unknown workflow'}; GET /api/scenario/participants/{id}/timeline returns 33+ merged items (events+state+alerts) for Cathy's Dorothy; POST /api/scenario/participants/{id}/events with event_type=hospitalised transitions lifecycle_state ACTIVE→HOSPITALISED and surfaces on the timeline; DEADLINE_CLOCKS registry includes _clock_budget_exhaustion_projected alongside 9 other clocks. Frontend (all green, 0 console errors/warnings across /app, /app/scenarios, /app/timeline, /app/participants, /app/participants/{id}/timeline): dashboard-timeline-panel rendered under the budget/insights cards with a 'View full timeline' link → /app/participants/{id}/timeline; /app/participants shows 2 participant-timeline-* links (Dorothy + Lebron) on the cards; clicking one navigates to /app/participants/{id}/timeline with timeline-page + timeline-feed + timeline-back-link present; /app/timeline (active-participant route) renders timeline-page WITHOUT the back link as designed; /app/scenarios renders workflows-panel with all 3 workflow-start-* buttons; clicking workflow-start-reassessment activates workflow-active-reassessment + workflow-progress + workflow-step-request, filling workflow-field-contact_method (Phone) + workflow-field-reference_number (REF-TEST-001) and clicking workflow-submit-request advances to step services_australia_letter; backend timeline confirms a freshly-emitted reassessment_requested event carrying payload {contact_method:'Phone', reference_number:'REF-TEST-001'}; Death workflow opens with workflow-route-out surfacing the resolved contact phones (1800 200 422 verified).
action_items: (Optional) The two budget-exhaustion-projection pytest tests gate on `days_into_quarter >= 14` and skip earlier than that — fine for prod but consider an opt-in env flag or freezegun mock so the projection logic is exercised in CI year-round.

(Optional, defensive) Brute-force lockout on the public ingress trapped both Cathy and the smoke account at start of run (a stale 'wait 56 minutes' state in Redis). Manual purge via rate_limit.reset_all_for_identifier or `redis-cli DEL rl:*` recovered. Consider exposing an internal admin endpoint or test helper for this so test agents don't have to drop into Redis directly.
critical_code_review_comments: scenario_engine.workflows.get_workflow correctly resolves route_out_contacts from the ESCALATE branch and merges them into the response — good.
DEADLINE_CLOCKS list registration confirmed (_clock_budget_exhaustion_projected is in position 5 of 10). No ordering issue.

WorkflowsPanel + DashboardTimelinePanel components are wired with the expected data-testids on every interactive element (workflow-start-*, workflow-active-*, workflow-step-*, workflow-progress, workflow-route-out, workflow-field-*, workflow-submit-*). Testing-friendly.

Statement-anomaly → typed-event mapping unit test (test_anomaly_to_event_mapping_emits_typed_events) covers 6 of the heaviest rule keys (RULE_1, RULE_9 wrong_stream + pension, RULE_10, RULE_12, RULE_13). LGTM; expansion to RULE_2/3/4/5/6/7/8 would harden the taxonomy further.
ParticipantTimeline now reads useParams().id when present and falls back to the active-participant resolver when absent — both routes confirmed working.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (15/15 Phase-6 UI assertions green, 0 console errors)
